[B1] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : Members, 'device' : UserDevice, ...) , ... > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY, Members), 'device' : UserDevice, ...) , ... > .
[B1] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : UserDevice, ...) , UserY : ('device' : nils, ...) , ... >
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : UserDevice, ...) , UserY : ('device' : UserDevice, ...) , ... > .
[B2] < deviceA | 'key' : Key, ... > < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceA, ...) , ... > $ UserX 'requestKey' cloudA | (deviceA)
=> < deviceA | 'key' : Key, ... > < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceA, ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'sendKey' UserX | (deviceA ; Key) .
[B2] < UserX | 'key' : nils, ... > $ cloudA 'sendKey' UserX | (DeviceX ; Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key, ... > .
[B3] < deviceA | 'key' : Key, 'on' : false, ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' deviceA | (Key)
=> < deviceA | 'key' : Key, 'on' : true, ... > .
[B4] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceA, ...) , ... > < deviceA | 'on' : false, ... > $ UserX 'turnOnCloud' cloudA | (deviceA)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceA, ...) , ... > < deviceA | 'on' : true, ... > .
[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY), ...) , UserY : ('device' : DeviceX, ...) , ... > $ UserX 'removeMember' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : nils, ...) , UserY : ('device' : nils, ...) , ... > .
